title: EnduroSat buys two dedicated New Glenn 7x2 launches from Blue Origin, the first scheduled for 2029
buyerNote: Dedicated launch capacity is being booked years ahead of flight.

title: Outpost Technologies selected for two Phase I NASA SBIR/STTR efforts on optical fiber manufacturing in microgravity
buyerNote: Early federal funding for in-space materials work; Phase I only.

title: Northrop Grumman books a sixth Falcon 9 for Cygnus and gives no readiness date for Antares 330
Verde Technologies signs a NASA contract to test perovskite solar cells outside the ISS through MISSE, NET June
buyerNote: A terrestrial solar maker validating its product in orbit before selling to spacecraft operators; six months of exposure, then returned for analysis.

title: LEAP announces a 32-launch agreement with an unnamed US defense startup, starting 2029 on its Bighorn vehicles
SpaceX launches two missions from Vandenberg SLC-4E 32 hours apart, a new same-pad turnaround record
Frontier Space reserves four Starlab middeck lockers; an unnamed pharmaceutical company wants to use some
buyerNote: Unnamed customer and no contract terms disclosed; an early sign of industrial interest in station lockers.

title: ULA says early data points to a fuel-supply problem, not the BE-4 engines, in Sunday's Vulcan failure
SEOPS signs a multi-launch rideshare deal with Stoke Space for Nova Block 2, from 2029; Payload reports SpaceX plans to sunset Falcon 9 rideshare around 2029
buyerNote: Rideshare options after 2029 are still being assembled; Nova has not yet flown.

title: ICEYE offers about €41 per share for 100% of Avio, maker of the Vega C launcher
Blue Origin reportedly leaving NASA's commercial station competition
buyerNote: Fewer candidate destinations to plan a research payload around.

title: Redwire wins a $20M contract for a second very-low-Earth-orbit demonstration mission
SpaceX flies Transporter-16 with 119 payloads
buyerNote: Rideshare remains the cheapest route to SSO, but manifests are crowded.

title: SpaceX rideshare list price rises to $7,000/kg (from $6,500) and dedicated Falcon 9 to about $74M
buyerNote: Re-check the current price sheet before budgeting a mission.

title: Vast moves Haven-1 to no earlier than Q1 2027; Axiom and Starlab two-module stations are planned for 2028 and 2029
buyerNote: No privately operated station is likely before 2027.
